content.title: OXM Q3 Deep Dive: Tariff Pressures and Promotional Activity Drive Mixed Results
content.summary: Fashion conglomerate Oxford Industries (NYSE:OXM) beat Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q3 CY2025, but sales were flat year on year at $307.3 million. On the other hand, next quarter’s revenue guidance of $375 million was less impressive, coming in 4.4% below analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP loss of $0.92 per share was 2.4% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

content.title: Oxford Industries (OXM) Q3 2025 Earnings Transcript
content.summary: The environment remained highly competitive and promotional, and the consumer continued to be selective with their discretionary spending, often requiring new and innovative product to catch your attention.  Strong sales growth in both the Emerging Brands Group and Lilly Pulitzer offset declines at Tommy Bahama and Johnny Was.  Total company comp sales were slightly positive, and while gross margins continue to reflect the pressures we've discussed in prior quarters related to tariffs, our underlying adjusted gross margin, absent that pressure, improved over last year's even in a highly competitive environment.
